description: This file defines the internal implementation of a time zone class within the Abseil C++ library, including methods for loading, querying, and transitioning time zones.

classes.name: time_zone::Impl
classes.description: Internal implementation class for managing time zone data and operations within the cctz namespace.

methods.name: UTC
methods.description: Returns the UTC time zone object.

methods.name: LoadTimeZone
methods.description: Loads a named time zone into the provided time_zone object.

methods.name: ClearTimeZoneMapTestOnly
methods.description: Clears cached time zone data, mainly for testing purposes.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name/ID of the time zone.

methods.name: BreakTime
methods.description: Converts a time_point to civil-time components in this time zone.

methods.name: MakeTime
methods.description: Converts civil-time components to a time_point in this time zone.

methods.name: NextTransition
methods.description: Finds the next offset transition after a given time.

methods.name: PrevTransition
methods.description: Finds the previous offset transition before a given time.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns a version string for the time zone.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a description string for the time zone.
